en_meaning: To think deeply or reflect profoundly about something
vi_meaning: Suy ngẫm, suy nghĩ thấu đáo
example_sentence: Before issuing his landmark judicial opinion, the Chief Justice retreated to his rural estate to cogitate on the constitutional limits of executive emergency decrees.

en_meaning: Related by descent from the same ancestral language or source
vi_meaning: Cùng nguồn gốc, có họ hàng gần
example_sentence: Comparative philologists demonstrated that English 'father' and Latin 'pater' are cognate words descended from a single Proto-Indo-European root.

en_meaning: Relating to the process of acquiring knowledge and understanding
vi_meaning: Thuộc về nhận thức
example_sentence: Developmental psychologists observed that interactive bilingual immersion significantly enhances executive function and cognitive flexibility in young children.

en_meaning: Knowledge, awareness, or notice of something
vi_meaning: Sự nhận biết, sự thẩm tri
example_sentence: The international war crimes tribunal took judicial cognizance of satellite imagery documenting deliberate attacks on civilian infrastructure.

en_meaning: To be united or logically connected
vi_meaning: Gắn kết chặt chẽ, mạch lạc
example_sentence: Although the archival manuscript contained fragmented testimonies from disparate witnesses, its core narrative threads cohere into a devastating chronicle of the siege.

en_meaning: The action or fact of forming a united whole
vi_meaning: Sự gắn kết, tính liên kết
example_sentence: Sociologists argue that widening income inequality erodes civic cohesion, fostering mutual suspicion among disparate economic classes.

en_meaning: An elaborate hairstyle or the manner of arranging hair
vi_meaning: Kiểu tóc cầu kỳ
example_sentence: In aristocratic portraits of the French court, noblewomen displayed towering powdered coiffures adorned with miniature porcelain ships and silk flora.

en_meaning: To invent or devise a new word or phrase
vi_meaning: Đặt ra, sáng tạo ra (từ ngữ, thuật ngữ)
example_sentence: Confronted by totalitarian atrocities unprecedented in legal history, jurist Raphael Lemkin was forced to coin the term 'genocide' in 1944.

en_meaning: A remarkable concurrence of events or circumstances without apparent causal connection
vi_meaning: Sự trùng hợp ngẫu nhiên
example_sentence: Historians dismissed the assertion that the simultaneous rebellions across three continents were a mere coincidence, pointing to synchronized grain shortages driven by volcanic eruptions.

en_meaning: A perforated bowl used to drain off liquids from food
vi_meaning: Cái rổ có lỗ thoát nước
example_sentence: Archaeologists excavating Pompeian culinary ruins recovered a remarkably preserved bronze colander perforated with intricate geometric drainage patterns.

en_meaning: To work jointly on an activity or project to produce something
vi_meaning: Hợp tác, cộng tác
example_sentence: To map the migration corridors of polar megafauna, climatologists and marine ecologists must collaborate across national and institutional boundaries.

en_meaning: A piece of art made by sticking various materials such as photographs and pieces of paper
vi_meaning: Nghệ thuật cắt dán, tác phẩm ghép mảnh
example_sentence: Dadaist artists assembled visceral collages of battlefield photographs, propaganda pamphlets, and industrial scrap to protest the senseless carnage of the Great War.

en_meaning: To collect and combine texts or information in a proper order
vi_meaning: Đối chiếu và sắp xếp tài liệu
example_sentence: Before publishing the definitive scholarly edition, textual critics spent years collating variant readings across dozens of medieval folios.

en_meaning: Something pledged as security for repayment of a loan, to be forfeited in the event of a default
vi_meaning: Tài sản thế chấp
example_sentence: Because the tenant farmers possessed no real estate to offer as collateral, commercial lenders routinely denied them the capital needed to modernize their equipment.

en_meaning: Used in ordinary or familiar conversation; not formal or literary
vi_meaning: Thông tục, mang tính khẩu ngữ
example_sentence: The novelist's dialogue achieves authentic emotional resonance by blending archaic pastoral cadences with brisk, colloquial city banter.

en_meaning: A thing that is composed of two or more separate elements; a mixture
vi_meaning: Hợp chất, phức hợp
example_sentence: When synthetic chemists exposed the volatile organic compound to ultraviolet radiation, its molecular bonds destabilized into inert gaseous byproducts.

en_meaning: Secret or illegal cooperation or conspiracy, especially in order to deceive others
vi_meaning: Sự câu kết, sự thông đồng bí mật
example_sentence: The investigative commission uncovered systemic collusion between maritime shipping cartels and regional port officials to suppress commercial competition.

en_meaning: Extremely large or great in size, extent, or degree
vi_meaning: Khổng lồ, to lớn dị thường
example_sentence: Deep beneath the ocean floor, sonar surveys detected a colossal caldera whose prehistoric collapse triggered global volcanic winters.

en_meaning: In a state of deep unconsciousness for a prolonged period; extremely lethargic
vi_meaning: Hôn mê, bất tỉnh
example_sentence: Suffering from severe cerebral hypoxia after the climbing accident, the mountaineer remained comatose for days while physicians monitored his brainstem reflexes.

en_meaning: Able to catch fire and burn easily; excitable
vi_meaning: Dễ cháy, dễ phát hỏa
example_sentence: Federal fire safety mandates require industrial warehouses to store combustible solvents in reinforced, temperature-regulated containment cells.

en_meaning: Pleasant to look at; attractive or agreeable
vi_meaning: Duyên dáng, thanh tú, ưa nhìn
example_sentence: In Thomas Hardy’s pastoral narratives, the protagonist is described as a comely country maiden whose rustic elegance contrasts sharply with Victorian vanity.

en_meaning: A punishment or fate that someone deserves for their bad actions
vi_meaning: Sự trừng phạt thích đáng, quả báo
example_sentence: The tyrannical mill owner finally met his comeuppance when a unified labor strike and subsequent government audits stripped him of his industrial monopoly.

en_meaning: To officially take control or possession of something, especially for military use
vi_meaning: Trưng dụng, trưng thu quân sự
example_sentence: As enemy regiments closed in on the capital, besieged commanders invoked martial law to commandeer commercial locomotives for civilian evacuation.

en_meaning: To honor or keep alive the memory of a person or event
vi_meaning: Kỷ niệm, tưởng niệm
example_sentence: The municipal assembly commissioned an obsidian memorial wall to commemorate the abolitionist reformers who organized the clandestine escape routes.

en_meaning: Corresponding in size, degree, or proportion
vi_meaning: Tương xứng, phù hợp
example_sentence: The university provost maintained that faculty compensation and research grants must be commensurate with institutional performance and scholarly impact.

en_meaning: To express or feel sympathy or pity for someone
vi_meaning: Bày tỏ sự cảm thông, chia sẻ nỗi buồn
example_sentence: Gathered around the hearth after the harvest failed, impoverished homesteaders could only commiserate over their mounting bank debts and blighted crops.

en_meaning: Roomy and comfortable; spacious
vi_meaning: Rộng rãi, thoáng đãng
example_sentence: The architect designed a commodious lecture hall with tiered acoustic seating capable of comfortably accommodating over five hundred scholars.

en_meaning: Shared by all members of a community for common use
vi_meaning: Thuộc về cộng đồng, dùng chung
example_sentence: Traditional Andean agrarian societies relied on communal irrigation networks maintained collectively by all village households.

en_meaning: Closely and neatly packed together; dense or concise
vi_meaning: Nhỏ gọn, kết cấu chặt chẽ
example_sentence: To withstand gale-force Arctic winds, the explorers erected a compact dome tent engineered from interlocking carbon-fiber struts.

en_meaning: Able to be likened to another; similar in quality or size
vi_meaning: Có thể so sánh được, tương đương
example_sentence: Economists studying inflationary spirals found that post-war monetary instability in the Weimar Republic had few comparable precedents in modern history.

en_meaning: Able to exist or occur together without conflict
vi_meaning: Tương thích, hòa hợp
example_sentence: Ecological philosophers debated whether unrestrained industrial consumerism is fundamentally compatible with global carbon neutrality.

en_meaning: Evoking interest, attention, or admiration in a powerfully irresistible way
vi_meaning: Có sức thuyết phục cao, hấp dẫn
example_sentence: The paleoclimatologist presented compelling empirical data demonstrating an unmistakable correlation between atmospheric carbon concentrations and prehistoric extinction events.

en_meaning: Intended to offset or make up for a loss or deficiency
vi_meaning: Có tính bù đắp, bồi thường
example_sentence: The appellate court upheld a multi-million-dollar compensatory settlement to mitigate the economic harm suffered by displaced coastal fisheries.

en_meaning: To collect and assemble information from various sources
vi_meaning: Biên soạn, thu thập và tổng hợp
example_sentence: It took decades for lexicographers to compile thousands of dialectal citations into the comprehensive historical dictionary of the English language.

en_meaning: A feeling of smug or uncritical satisfaction with oneself
vi_meaning: Sự tự mãn, chủ quan
example_sentence: Prolonged fiscal surplus bred political complacency, blinding municipal policymakers to mounting infrastructure deficits until the bridges failed.

en_meaning: willing to please others or to accept what they want or do
vi_meaning: Chiều chuộng, hay nhân nhượng, dễ dãi
example_sentence: Eager to secure corporate sponsorships, the complaisant university trustees ratified the commercial contract without imposing any academic safeguards.

en_meaning: something that completes or makes something else perfect
vi_meaning: Phần bổ sung, vật hoàn thiện
example_sentence: In physiological psychology, quantitative brain scans serve as an indispensable complement to qualitative behavioral observation.

en_meaning: combining in such a way as to enhance or emphasize each other's qualities
vi_meaning: Bổ trợ lẫn nhau, tương hỗ
example_sentence: The botanist demonstrated that nitrogen-fixing legumes and deep-rooted grasses establish complementary rhizosphere relationships that enrich nutrient-poor soils.

en_meaning: the action or fact of complying with a wish or command
vi_meaning: Sự tuân thủ, sự phục tùng
example_sentence: Regulatory agencies threatened severe financial sanctions if the chemical conglomerate failed to demonstrate full compliance with hazardous waste disposal statutes.

en_meaning: inclined to agree with others or obey rules, especially to an excessive degree
vi_meaning: Dễ phục tùng, ngoan ngoãn tuân thủ
example_sentence: Authoritarian regimes depend upon a compliant judiciary to rubber-stamp executive decrees and suppress dissent under the guise of legal procedure.

en_meaning: The state of being involved with others in an illegal activity or wrongdoing
vi_meaning: Sự đồng lõa, sự tòng phạm
example_sentence: Declassified diplomatic cables exposed the foreign ministry's tacit complicity in financing covert paramilitary operations overseas.

en_meaning: A part or element of a larger whole
vi_meaning: Thành phần, bộ phận cấu thành
example_sentence: Rigorous empirical replication remains an essential component of modern scientific methodology, guarding against flawed experimental designs.

en_meaning: The state of being calm and in control of oneself
vi_meaning: Sự điềm tĩnh, sự tự chủ
example_sentence: Despite virulent heckling from partisan demonstrators outside the parliament, the prime minister maintained her composure throughout the policy address.

en_meaning: Complete and including all or nearly all elements or aspects of something
vi_meaning: Toàn diện, bao quát
example_sentence: The environmental agency released a comprehensive longitudinal study assessing the cumulative ecological impacts of hydraulic fracturing on municipal aquifers.

en_meaning: To squeeze or press together to force into less space
vi_meaning: Nén lại, ép chặt
example_sentence: Subduction zones at convergent tectonic plate boundaries compress marine sediments under tremendous geothermal pressure, converting them into metamorphic schist.

en_meaning: To include, contain, or consist of specific parts
vi_meaning: Bao gồm, gồm có
example_sentence: The interdisciplinary research consortium will comprise geneticists, computational statisticians, and clinical oncologists from across four continents.

en_meaning: An agreement reached by each side making concessions
vi_meaning: Sự thỏa hiệp, sự dàn xếp
example_sentence: Historians consider the Great Compromise of 1787 crucial to the formation of the American republic, as it established proportional representation in the House alongside equal representation in the Senate.

en_meaning: A feeling of guilt or moral scruple that prevents wrongdoing
vi_meaning: Sự cắn rứt lương tâm, sự ân hận
example_sentence: Driven by ruthless corporate ambition, the unscrupulous financier raided the pension funds of thousands of factory workers without a twinge of compunction.

en_meaning: To calculate an amount or figure mathematically
vi_meaning: Tính toán, ước tính bằng số liệu
example_sentence: Early mechanical calculating machines designed by Charles Babbage relied on brass gear trains to compute polynomial mathematical tables with unprecedented precision.

en_meaning: Curved inward like the interior of a circle or sphere
vi_meaning: Lõm, cong vào trong
example_sentence: Astronomical observatories utilize massive concave mirrors to gather distant photons from faint celestial objects and converge them onto sensitive charge-coupled detectors.
